title: Scoped Search
summary: A search bar with a scope selector attached.
description: A search bar with a scope selector attached.
accessibility_notes: Result counts belong in an aria-live region; filter groups need fieldset/legend so their scope is announced.
ai_usage: Search across multiple collections. Keep the scope in the same control group so the user sees what they are searching before they type, not after they get results.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Scoped Search</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "search-bar-scoped",
    "title": "Scoped Search",
    "summary": "A search bar with a scope selector attached.",
    "description": "A search bar with a scope selector attached.",
    "theme": "search-ui",
    "categories": ["search", "filter"],
    "tags": ["search", "find", "scope", "select", "bar", "filter"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Result counts belong in an aria-live region; filter groups need fieldset/legend so their scope is announced.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--c", "description": "Action colour", "default": "#7c5cff" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Adapt to a light theme", "Add a compact variant"],
    "ai_usage": "Search across multiple collections. Keep the scope in the same control group so the user sees what they are searching before they type, not after they get results."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    .fx { display: flex; width: 300px; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #2b3450; background: #151b2a; }
    .fx select { border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #2b3450; background: #1c2437; color: #cbd5e1; font: inherit;
      font-size: .82rem; padding: 0 .7rem; }
    .fx input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: .75rem .9rem; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #e7ebf3; font: inherit; }
    .fx input:focus { outline: none; }
    .fx button { padding: 0 1rem; border: 0; background: #7c5cff; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form class="fx" role="search"><label class="sr" for="sc" style="position:absolute;left:-9999px">Scope</label>
  <select id="sc"><option>All</option><option>Effects</option><option>Themes</option></select>
  <label class="sr" for="sq" style="position:absolute;left:-9999px">Search</label>
  <input id="sq" type="search" placeholder="Search 1,181 specimens" />
  <button type="submit" aria-label="Search">⌕</button></form>
</body>
</html>
